title: Plaisir d'amour
artist: Jean-Paul-Égide Martini / Jean-Pierre Claris de Florian
attribution: Romance by Jean-Paul-Égide Martini (died 1816) to a poem by Jean-Pierre Claris de Florian (died 1794), published in 1784. Public domain: published before 1931 (United States) and all authors died before 1972 (Canada). Melody from the Leduc voice-and-piano edition (Gallica, via Wikimedia Commons); the refrain, the first couplet and the refrain again (the second couplet, in F minor, is left out).
